title: Choosing direction while welcoming the new

captions.energy: Advancing a purpose that benefits others
captions.emotions: Joy in a new open experience

meaning: Progress towards a meaningful result can inspire you when choosing together preserves the pleasure of an open new experience.
text: You can choose a direction without knowing your entire future role. The Chariot in the energy of Sahasrara supports a wish to advance a meaningful intention and move through obstacles. The Lovers in the physical position describe shared actions: discussing close values, voluntarily choosing participation and confirming agreement through a decision. The Fool in emotions brings the free pleasure of new experience. It feels rewarding that a shared path already has an accessible beginning while further acquaintance stays open. Your contribution can become useful to others without requiring the entire future result to be determined immediately.

For example, you choose together to help at a small observatory’s first open day. You both want to make a distant subject more accessible and accept manageable participation. **A freely shared choice connects direction with the pleasure of a new beginning.** Someone asks a question missing from preparation, bringing fresh interest. Your decision supports a living opportunity to learn, while the endeavour can develop through new subjects, others’ discoveries and participants’ own wish to return and try.

The difficulty may arise if agreement requires a final role for the project’s whole future. A manageable first contribution is delayed while you debate what it should eventually become. Directed motivation and the pleasure of openness remain supportive. Action benefits from a sufficient first step, accepting one task without deciding the entire later history and leaving future encounters room to surprise you.
